digest.component_or_area: S3 remote store push and init
propositions: Without a git-remote-s3 helper or with a version below 0.3.2, driving an s3:// or s3+zip:// remote causes silent store corruption via duplicate bundles instead of failing early.
S3 mode must be detected by resolving the configured sync.remote URL and checking if its scheme is s3:// or s3+zip://, then calling require_s3_helper() to validate the helper is present and >=0.3.2.

The S3 preflight must raise OptionalDependencyError unconditionally (overriding best-effort semantics) so that it propagates through write_and_push and is re-raised in push_after_commit, aborting the corrupting push while leaving the local commit durable.

The preflight helper _require_s3_helper_if_s3_url() must be called after URL resolution in three places: push.py synchronous always path (line ~418), push.py async arm before detaching, and init.py _mount_or_create_branch, reusing existing git remote get-url calls without new resolutions.
Non-S3 remotes (file://, GitHub-style) and unresolvable remotes keep existing best-effort behavior with no helper required and no change to error handling.
No new config schema key is introduced; the existing sync.remote field is reused to detect S3 mode by URL scheme alone.
